stem.text: Equal masses of barium carbonate and magnesium carbonate powders are mixed together. The mixture is then heated using a Bunsen burner flame until there is no further change. A gas is given off.

items: The residue left after heating reacts with aqueous hydrochloric acid to produce carbon dioxide.
The percentage decrease in mass after heating is 26% (to 2 significant figures).
The gas given off during heating relights a glowing splint.
